manifest.source: Complete Rosetta rosetta-groundtruth/1 stream inventory plus type-preserving controlled native events journals.

events.notes: Writer JSON Schema for persisted session events (ephemeral streaming types omitted). Field requiredness is the schema contract; fixtures prove what the CLI actually writes.

session-plans.notes: Per-session agent planning document when plan mode is used.

session-checkpoints.notes: Checkpoint history. 1.0.80 writes checkpoints/index.md (markdown table); compaction scenarios may add numbered JSON snapshots.

session-files.notes: Session-scoped artifacts the agent created during the turn.

session-research.notes: Per-session research/ scratch directory. The CLI creates it empty on every farmed session; no files observed yet.

session-workspace.notes: Per-session workspace metadata: id, cwd, client_name, name, timestamps.

session-db.notes: Per-session SQLite (todos, todo_deps, inbox_entries). Distinct from the derived session-store.db index. The agent documents this as the default 'session' SQL database in system.message.

session-locks.notes: Volatile process locks; stripped at harvest.

session-store.notes: Derived, rebuildable SQLite index (`/chronicle reindex`). EXCLUDE from harvest and from parsers — events.jsonl is the source of truth.

settings.notes: User-editable JSONC settings (model, autoUpdate, remoteExport, …). Farm writes a hermetic stub; the CLI may rewrite it.

config.notes: Automatically managed application state (JSONC with leading comments). May contain authentication — MUST-NOT-PARSE beyond inventory. Farm observed firstLaunchAt only.

permissions.notes: Saved tool/directory approvals keyed by absolute project path.

logs.notes: Per-process debug logs (`process-{timestamp}-{pid}.log`). Volatile; stripped at harvest.

command-history.notes: Interactive reverse-search command history. Not transcript ground truth.

copilot-instructions.notes: Personal custom instructions applied to every session.

installed-plugins.notes: Marketplace plugin payloads. Vendor bundle; stripped at harvest.

plugin-data.notes: Persistent data owned by installed plugins.

mcp-oauth.notes: MCP OAuth fallback tokens — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only.

mcp-secrets.notes: MCP secret placeholder fallback storage — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only.

farm:headless-stdout.notes: Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.

claims.notes: Digest-pinned Rosetta record inventory whose occurrence count is non-zero. It proves occurrence; it proves retained shape only for records classified as fixture or observed rather than writer evidence.
Digest-pinned complete Rosetta stream/shape inventory for copilot@1.0.80; writer-only and zero-occurrence records establish a reviewable contract lead, not runtime occurrence.
